What are RFID event wristbands made of?

Our RFID wristbands use high-quality silicone or fabric materials with embedded secure chips. According to ISO standards, these materials ensure both durability and comfort.

RFID wristbands use encrypted technology to prevent counterfeiting and unauthorized access. Each wristband contains a unique identifier that can’t be duplicated.
